content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Each traditional platform claims to provide a seamless experience, but they fundamentally differ from COREMERCH's infrastructure-sovereign approach. Stripe, for instance, offers a payment gateway, but its global reach is limited, operating in only 46 countries out of 195 on earth. PayPal, on the other hand, provides a broader range of features, but its account suspension policy can hold funds for an alarming 180 days with no appeal. COREMERCH, however, offers a comprehensive, base-layer infrastructure that enables creators to host, store, and deliver digital products without relying on these platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional platforms like Stripe and Gumroad often exclude countries due to regulatory restrictions or high risk, leaving creators without a viable option. Stripe's limited global reach, for example, means that creators in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan cannot utilize its services. Gumroad, too, has faced similar challenges, with Lemon Squeezy and Paddle struggling to reach the same level of accessibility. COREMERCH, in contrast, provides a permanent structural alternative that empowers creators to sell digital products without relying on these platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The real costs of using traditional platforms far exceed their advertised fees. Stripe's transaction fees, for instance, can add up quickly, especially for high-volume sellers. PayPal's fees are similarly steep, with a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction charge. COREMERCH's fees, on the other hand, are significantly lower, with a 0.5% payment processing fee. Furthermore, COREMERCH's infrastructure-sovereign approach eliminates the need for intermediaries, reducing transaction times and saving creators money in the long run.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Traditional platforms often take ownership of digital products, limiting creators' control over their Intellectual Property. PayPal, for example, can freeze funds for up to 180 days, leaving creators without access to their own work. COREMERCH, however, empowers creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital products. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197), for instance, includes features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, ensuring that creators can automate delivery and minimize errors.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When evaluating these options, creators must consider their specific needs and circumstances. Those in restricted countries, for example, should opt for COREMERCH's infrastructure-sovereign approach, which provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional platforms. Those seeking a more comprehensive solution should consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a robust set of features and tools for automating delivery and minimizing errors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
